return.title: Return {month} to HR?
return.body: HR's payroll for this month becomes a draft again, so HR can fix it and approve it again. Its taxes are dropped until then, and HR's approvers are told why.
return.reasonPlaceholder: For example: a penalty for EMP-0012 is missing

finalize.title: Finalize {month}?
finalize.body: Confirm that the salaries were transferred. A finalized month can't be returned to HR, and this can't be undone.

statement.limitedTitle: You see the amounts of {seen} of {total} employees.
statement.limitedBody: Salaries outside your role's scope are hidden, so the month's totals are hidden too. They show only to someone who sees every salary.
statement.methodTitle: How each line is worked out
statement.method: The taxable amount is the one that, after its income tax and the martyrs' fund, leaves exactly the net. Gross = net + insurance share + income tax + martyrs' fund. Frozen at approval: a later change to the rule or to anyone's insurance never changes this statement.
statement.printNote: Printed from the school's system. Amounts in EGP.
